description: A decision that needs an answer, or a short focused task (DESIGN.md, Dialog): a box at most 420 wide (size lg: 560) of title, body in TsuyaColors.textMuted, optional content, and actions at the end, wrapping when needed — put the main one last. Show it with Dialog.show; it is modal, traps focus, and puts it first on the least destructive action: the first of actions (so, usually, Cancel), or initialFocus. alert gives it the alert dialog role, for one that interrupts.

params.name: title
params.description: What is being asked, in TsuyaType.titleM; also its accessible name.

params.name: body
params.description: A sentence of explanation under the title, announced with it.

params.name: content
params.description: Anything else under the body: a field, a list.

params.name: actions
params.description: Buttons at the end, the main one last.

params.name: size
params.description: How wide it grows at most.

params.name: alert
params.description: Announces it as an alert dialog: it interrupts what the person was doing.

params.name: initialFocus
params.description: The node to focus first, instead of the first action.

statics.name: show
statics.signature: Future<T?> show<T>(BuildContext context, {required WidgetBuilder builder, bool dismissible = true, String? barrierLabel})
statics.description: Shows builder's dialog above everything, over a scrim, and completes with what close gives, or null once dismissed. Escape and a press on the scrim dismiss it unless dismissible is false (a required decision: only an action's close ends it). barrierLabel names the scrim for a screen reader, which can then dismiss it; it is left out when not dismissible.

statics.name: close
statics.description: Closes the dialog context belongs to, completing Dialog.show's future with result.
